svg.title: Here ρ = (1 −cos E)/E ≥0 for E > 0, ρ(0) = 0, |ρ| ≤1 and ρ(E) ≥E/π on [0, 1]. Fubini makes D the spatial Fourier transform of the sum of positive ρμ and spatially reflected ρν measures. It is bounded by M and supported in radius R. For 0 < u ≤1, choose smooth bump Bu equal to one on momentum radius u, supported within 2u, between zero and one. Its Fourier transform is bounded in absolute value by the volume of the radius-2u ball, hence by C3u3. Fourier inversion and positivity imply Z ρ(E)Bu(pspatial) dμ ≤K(R, M)u3, μ{u/2 < E ≤u} ≤2πK(R, M)u2.
